subject: Anmeldung unserer Zwillinge für die Bambini/U10 — ein paar Fragen dazu

triage.summary: Mother Claudia Bergmann wants to register her twins Jakob and Johanna (both born 2017) for the Bambini/U10 for the new season and asks practical questions, most importantly about storing Jakob's asthma inhaler with the trainer (routine fee/sibling-discount and payment questions accompany the signup).
triage.proposed_action: Send the registration form/path by email to enroll both twins immediately; relay Jakob's asthma/inhaler info and the attached doctor's certificate to the Bambini/U10 coach; answer the sibling-discount and SEPA direct debit questions and list any required documents.

details.address: Am Sportpark 12, 53783 Eitorf (family recently moved from Bonn)
details.attachment: medical certificate (ärztliche Bescheinigung) for Jakob's asthma
details.medical_note: Jakob uses an asthma inhaler after longer runs; pediatrician clears him for sport, nothing serious; parent asks whether the trainer can store the inhaler
questions: flexible team switches within U10 (Johanna still hesitant)
sibling discount on annual fee + SEPA direct debit payment
which documents are needed before start
details.referral: Nadine Okafor (daughter Mia plays in the club's U16)

policy_reason: Policy escalation: 'signup' is normally auto, but flag 'medical' matches ask_if
